description: Use before recommending or installing an integration: find apps that integrate with an ecosystem (xero, quickbooks-online, hubspot, vercel, netlify), filtered and ranked for a buyer profile per Lode ranking policy (fit, not size or features). Returns score, match reasons and ties. Only published (verified) records are ranked; records still under review can be fetched by id with get_integration.

budget.description: Monthly budget for this tool in USD, as a number or one of: free, under-50, 50-200, 200-1000, over-1000

company_stage.description: One of: solo, startup, smb, mid-market, enterprise

ecosystem.description: Ecosystem slug, e.g. "xero", "quickbooks-online", "hubspot", "vercel", "netlify" (names like "QuickBooks" are accepted)

existing_stack.description: Apps and platforms the buyer already uses, e.g. ["supabase","nextjs","vercel","stripe"] (up to 12). Results mark any app already in the stack. Product names only, never people or company names

framework.description: The app's framework, one of: nextjs, react, remix, astro, sveltekit, nuxt, vue, angular, express, nestjs, django, flask, fastapi, rails, laravel, spring, dotnet, go, react-native, flutter, other

needs.description: Sync objects the buyer must have, from the ecosystem vocabulary (see list_ecosystems), e.g. ["invoices","inventory-levels"]; labels and common synonyms such as "customers" are accepted

region.description: Buyer country: AU, NZ, UK, US, CA, IE, ZA, SG (GB, country names and locale tags such as en-GB are accepted); filters to apps that support it. Prices are compared in local currency for AU, NZ, UK, US and CA, and in USD elsewhere

name: find_integrations
title: Find integrations for a buyer
